reason: Close a residual fail-open request-failure classification bug in the revision-44 post-teardown Security gate. ERR_ABORTED was ignored unconditionally, so a real abort during navigation, teaching interactions, lazy-resource loading or media playback before teardown could escape despite listeners remaining attached. Revision 45 makes ERR_ABORTED ignorable only after context teardown begins, adds deterministic mutations proving pre-teardown ERR_ABORTED is fatal while teardown-only aborts are tolerated, and reruns the exact ES/EN Security 00/1.1 desktop/mobile normal/reduced interaction+media matrix. Site-facing bytes remain unchanged from b44a3e9d; keep global SOURCE/RENDERED and Security MEDIA fail-closed and do not grant ARTICLE_GOLDEN.
